description: A conformance record (which rules were checked, findings, deviations) exists before release.
name: cert_conformance_recorded

description: Every deviation records the violation rationale and is approved.
name: cert_deviation_documented

description: No Level L1 finding remains open at release.
name: cert_no_open_l1_at_release

description: Each finding has a Priority (Severity × Likelihood × Remediation Cost, 1–27) and resulting Level (L1/L2/L3) assigned.
name: cert_priority_assigned

description: Departures from CERT Recommendations (advisory guidelines) are recorded.
name: cert_recommendation_departure_recorded

description: Every finding is risk-assessed on the three CERT factors: severity, likelihood, and remediation cost.
name: cert_risk_assessed

description: Violations of CERT Rules (normative) are remediated, or covered by an approved deviation.
name: cert_rule_violation_remediated

description: Source is checked against the CERT C / C++ ruleset by static analysis before it is committed.
name: cert_static_analysis_before_commit

description: Potential violations of undecidable rules (not fully checkable by static analysis) are manually reviewed.
name: cert_undecidable_manual_review
